title: Axiomarium maturity levels
description: registry/maturity.yaml: what each maturity level promises, and the evidence an asset needs before it claims the level.

levels.description: Every level, from the least trusted to the most, in the order of the asset schema's maturity values.

level.description: One level and the evidence it needs. Evidence left out isn't needed.

name.description: The level, as a manifest's maturity names it.

promise.description: What the level promises to someone using the asset. Only promise what the evidence shows.

usage.description: How many usage entries in docs/dogfooding.md must link to the asset.

repos.description: How many different repos those usage entries must name.

evals.description: The eval types every asset needs.

skill_evals.description: The eval types a skill needs on top of evals.

eval.description: An eval type, as a manifest's evals names it.
